extracted.name: Quick and Easy Carrot and Chickpea Salad
extracted.description: Carrot and chickpea salad tossed in a simple lemon vinaigrette is a quick and easy salad for lunch or side dish for dinner.
ingredient_lines: freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 (14 ounce) can chickpeas (garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until dressing is smooth. Add carrots, chickpeas, parsley, and onion; toss to coat.
